mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand for residential construction, directly accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate accelerating supply chain activity and consumer demand, which consistently produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST rise by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.05), rising interest rates reduce the present value of equity cash flows, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.2% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 130,000 (PAYEMS > 130000) signals strong labor market conditions that increase disposable income and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) rise and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, it indicates strong consumer demand without monetary constraint, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises by at least 0.3% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 90), declining industrial output reduces corporate production capacity and increases volatility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.
